meta.title: Yukikaki — We clear the path before the builders arrive.
meta.description: Builders are not the bottleneck. Project Yukikaki does the work before they arrive: defined problems, the data behind them, buy-in from the people who must say yes, a venue, funding and the right teams.

nav.tagline: We clear the path before the builders arrive.

landing.heroAlt: A child shovels a snowy path to a glowing hall where builders arrive.
landing.mascotEmpty: Nothing here yet — bring a problem?
landing.lead: In a Hokkaido winter, someone shovels the path before anyone else can get through. We do that for the people who build.
landing.title: Builders are not the bottleneck.
landing.subtitle: What's missing is the work before they arrive.
landing.needs: Defined problems, the data behind them, buy-in from the people who must say yes, a venue, funding and the right teams.

landing.howTitle: Six workstreams, cleared before day one
landing.howLead: Builders get a real problem, real data and a real owner from the first hour.
landing.ws1: A short voice interview turns a shop owner's headache into a clear, scoped brief.
landing.ws2: Public statistics and comparable towns, every source cited. Private data stays private.
landing.ws3: We map the people who must say yes, and draft the ask for each of them.
landing.ws4: Candidate spaces close to the problem, ready for the host to book.
landing.ws5: Matching grants and sponsors, with the eligibility rules attached.
landing.ws6: Builders matched by skill. Each team has one lead who supports the owner for 90 days.
landing.howApproval: AI does the legwork; the host approves each output.
landing.p1: AI drafts briefs, matches and checks. A named person approves every one.
landing.p2: Every claim links to its source. When there is no source, it says so.
landing.p3: Every challenge has an owner, and every team has a lead the owner can reach.
landing.p4: Private data stays private. When real data can't be shared, clearly labelled synthetic stand-ins take its place.
landing.p5: Challenges come from businesses in the town, in their own words.
landing.p6: Fewer hands, same town. Owners, builders and the town share the work.
landing.w1: Fewer hands, same town. One screen to approve everything, and a running tally of hours given back.
landing.w2: The task that eats your week, handled, plus a lead who answers your questions for 90 days.
landing.w3: A real problem, real data and a real owner from the first hour. Work that ships and gets used.
landing.w4: Support that lands in the community, with measured impact you can point to.
landing.testimonialsNote: Quotes appear exactly as owners gave them in their impact review.
landing.closingBody: Bring a problem from your business, or bring Yukikaki to your town.
